records.rationale: In the new webhook handler (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`), it does a read-then-write sequence: `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId: reqBody.userId, appId: appMetadata.slug } })` and if not found it calls `prisma.credential.create(...)`. records.issue_text: parseRefreshTokenResponse injects fake 'refresh_token' placeholder for all non-sync callers including zoom, masking provider-side revocation
records.rationale:
In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the secret check uses direct indexed header lookup and a normal string comparison:
```ts
req.headers[process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME || "calcom-webhook-secret"] !== process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
```
Node/Next lowercases incoming header keys on `req.headers`, but the env-provided header name is not normalized in code, so a non-lowercase `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME` will fail to match (case-sensitive property access).
